Pomegranate Champagne Fizz
By: Karina
Published: Sunday, May 15, 2011 - 8:20pm

Ingredients




1 ounce Bombay Sapphire gin
1 ounce pomegranate juice
1/2 ounce fresh lemon juice
1/4 ounce elderflower syrup or other berry syrup
1/4 cup champagne

Preparation

1 In shaker combine gin, pomegranate juice, syrup and ice. Shake; strain into champagne flute. Top with champagne.

About

Garnish with cranberries, blackberry, or the berry of your choice!
